text:
Type: aluminium dome pendant lamp
Use: light over a dining table, a kitchen island or a desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: industrial, retro, modern
Materials: brushed aluminium shade and ceiling cup, black fabric cord, white inner shade
Colors: silver aluminium, black, white
Shape: wide flared dome shade with a narrow neck, hangs on a long thin cord, metallic sheen, medium size, clean outline
Feel: cool, urban, crisp, functional
Goes with: concrete, white tiles, black metal, wood tables; industrial kitchens, modern lofts
